person_note: The novel alternates sustained narrative persons: Edwin, Mirella, and Olive are narrated in third person, while Gaspery becomes a participating first-person narrator in Part 4 and later sections. The quote set independently reflects both modes: q07584 and q07593 expose close third-person narration, while q07573 is Gaspery’s confirmed first-person ending narration and q07590 is a constitutive collective first-person event fragment. Panel speech, dialogue, universal “you,” and gnomic “we” were treated as local or nondiagnostic. Confidence is medium because the whole-book alternating structure is described by Tier C guides, while stronger sources establish only individual components.
